Class Bio7Dialog

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.batch.Bio7Dialog
public class Bio7Dialog extends Object
This class provides some default dialogs for the Bio7 application.

    • decision

      public static boolean decision(String text)
      Opens a decision Dialog with the given text. The decision dialog will set the variable in the Flow editor of the bio7 application to true or false depending on the decision. In addition the selected boolean will be returned.
      Parameters:
      text - the text for the dialog.
      Returns:
      a boolean value.
